title: The Doppelganger
text: At dawn there is one Scion too many in camp. Two of them sit by the fire with the same face, the same scars, the same way of holding a cup. Each swears to be the real one. Both seem frightened, unless both are very good at it.

options.label: The sharpest asks them both what only the real one could know.

outcomes.text: The false one fumbles a childhood name. Its face slips and it runs; that night nobody sleeps near the fire.
Both answer perfectly. Then both smile, in exactly the same way.

options.label: Keep both close until one gives itself away, and never turn your back.

outcomes.text: It gives itself away at the worst possible moment, with a knife, still wearing the face you trusted.

options.label: Test them both with silver, and see whose skin can bear it.

outcomes.text: The silver burns one of them. It stops pretending, and what lies underneath is not a person.
